keywords: the ass in the lion's skin
full_text:
An ass found the skin of a lion left by hunters on the grass. Slipping his legs into the paws and pulling the massive mane over his head, he strutted through the countryside. Beasts and men fled in sheer terror before the apparition of the King of Beasts.

Exulting in his borrowed glory, the donkey encountered his master on the road. Wishing to terrify the man who had driven him with a stick, the ass opened his mouth to roar.

Out came a deafening, unmistakable bray: "HEE-HAW! HEE-HAW!"

The master laughed heartily, grasped his stout hazel cudgel, and gave the disguised beast a sound thrashing across his ribs, saying: "You may frighten the sheep with that skin, you fool, but your ridiculous bray proves you are the same lazy donkey you have always been!"
moral: Pretending to be what you are not only invites mockery when your true nature appears.
